chunks: He said: 'My Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached old age and decrepitude?'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Zakariyya say about having a child in old age?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Maryam, Prophet Zakariyya (AS) articulates his astonishment at the divine promise of a son, emphasizing the dual obstacles of his wife's barrenness and his own advanced age ('itiyyan). Shia scholars often highlight this as a model of humble supplication, where the prophet acknowledges human limitations to underscore God's absolute power (Qudrah) to create life against all natural laws.
